set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- API supports separate penalties, positive entropy, warm starts, and stable computation.
- Result reports mass, KL/marginal diagnostics, decomposition, convergence, and status.
- POT differentials cover balanced limit, strong imbalance, and asymmetric penalties.
- Small epsilon/extreme penalties have finite documented behavior.
- FUGW and UCOOT reuse the same semantics.
set.title: Expose KL-unbalanced entropic OT as a public primitive
